events.detail: Primary goal B accepted for the astronaut, with return to base A.
Planning route A to B and back.
Route r1 published on map v1 (orbital CTX map only). The corridor is still uncertain.
Astronaut departs from base A on route r1.
Route r1 crosses cells with sigma 3 m. Drone reconnaissance requested.
Drone flies over the corridor.
Observation obs-001 covers 989 cells across the corridor.
Map v2: drone saw a scarp across the corridor with local slope up to 51° (illustrative human limit 20°).
Inspection candidate C: real Perseverance science site Salette (rock core sample of the rock Brac, South Séítah, sol 262).
Inspection candidate D: real Perseverance science site Swift Run (rock core sample of the rock Skinner Ridge, Delta Front, sol 490).
Route r1 crosses the scarp seen in map v2 (slope above 20°). Astronaut halted at the current position.
Replanning from the astronaut position.
Route r2 goes around the scarp. Round trip -227 s versus r1, still within budget.
Astronaut resumes on route r2.
Rover round trip to C needs about 1806 Wh, within the usable 3760 Wh (20 % reserve kept).
Rover round trip to D needs about 5747 Wh around the scarp, above the usable 3760 Wh (20 % reserve kept). Not assigned.
Rover inspecting Salette.
Inspection of Salette complete (simulated). Sampling not requested in this run.
Astronaut reached goal B and starts the science task.
Primary goal B completed.
Returning to base A on the return leg of r2.
Astronaut back at base A. Goal completed, return verified under the model, no budget violation.

Photo tour: the rover will visit all 226 real Perseverance stops of this map (sol 13 to 708), in the order NASA's rover visited them. Illustrative speed; resource use is not modelled during the tour. 1 stop at the crop edge is visited from 20 m inside it.
Rover leaves base for the first real stop.
Rover visited all 226 real stops.
